meta.note: DBIE report 1734, data provider "Query 1". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor). Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: Item Hierarchy Level 1, Item Description; measures: value. Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
